description: Voice2QR JS library: record real voice as Codec2 parameters inside a QR code (QV format v2).
name: voice2qr

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.json --emitDeclarationOnly && node scripts/bundle.mjs && node scripts/prepare-assets.mjs
scripts.build:app: vite build && node scripts/make-icons.mjs && node scripts/assemble-site.mjs
